ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( NSP_Task_Subtype__c, "Nurture/Regen"), OR( ISCHANGED(ActivityDate), ActivityDate - 90 > DATEVALUE(CreatedDate), ActivityDate - 90 > TODAY() ) )
